govdocs-archive_org-nsia-FBIWarrenCommis: This G-man chat with Texas boss John Connally — December 11, 1963 — is a Bureau file. The opened chat is a first-hand source. The boss took a bullet in Dallas. His words count. Bookmen prize such files. The file fits the JFK-killing shelf.
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-KinneyEdwardChr: This note on Navy medical testimony — April 25, creator unknown — is a file. The Navy doctors performed the autopsy. The note may hold a clue. The file belongs to the assassination archive. The item is a fragment of the record.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-adelmann: This 1913 reference piece on Adelmann — the Bishop of Brescia who stood up to Berengar — tells of an old fight over the Eucharist. Francis Grey follows the debate. His letter backed the true Presence of Christ. The schools still cite his stand. His short book on the Body of Christ settled many minds.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-alexander-kau: This 1913 reference article on Alexander Kaufmann — the German poet and writer. Karl Hoeber notes his works. His verse served faith and fatherland. The entry preserves his modest fame. A singer of the Catholic revival. His ballads sang the Rhine legends.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-antony-kohlma: This 1913 reference article on Antony Kohlmann — the Jesuit of old New York. Thomas Meehan tells his pioneer labors. He served the city's first Catholics. The restored Society sent its best. A founder of the American mission. His parish was old St. Peter's.
